name: Window position
author: Dave Brownell
description: Where the focused window sits in the scrolling layout

barWidget.description: Carousel pips showing the focused window's place in the workspace's tiling, with a hover readout

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Pips, a numeric counter, or both.

schema.label: Max pips
schema.description: Fall back to the counter once the workspace needs more marks than this — one per band, plus one per floating window.

schema.label: Max stacked windows
schema.description: Fall back to the counter once a single pip has to hold more windows than this. A pip is five pixels tall, so a deeper stack cannot give each window a pixel.

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often to re-check the window arrangement. Hyprland emits no event when windows are repositioned, so this is the only way to notice a swap.
